headline: Simplify Your Emails: 21 Practical Tactics
body: 21 short, practical email marketing tactics you can apply one at a time.
caption: Email marketing can feel like a big job, but it doesn't have to be. We've put together 21 simple, practical email marketing tactics that you can pick up and use right away. Each one is designed to help you connect better with your audience without feeling overwhelmed. Think of them as small, actionable steps to make your emails work harder for you.
